justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Objective functional baseline; RTW prediction is the primary goal but predictive validity studies show modest accuracy.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 1-2 day training program; ~$300-500; several proprietary systems available.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable primarily in occupational health, workers compensation, and disability evaluation settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: FCE has dedicated billing codes; workers compensation is primary payer; disability evaluation referrals are a significant revenue stream.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Steady demand in workers compensation and disability evaluation; specialized but consistent hiring.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients with valid effort appreciate objectivity; secondary gain situations reduce trust.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Not consumer cash-pay, but third-party payers (attorneys, employers, workers' comp) pay directly and well — functionally similar to cash.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: FCEs command $800-$2,500 per evaluation with strong margins.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Certified FCE providers are a defined niche with steady referral channels.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Highly scalable — trained associates and PTAs can conduct FCEs under a clinic brand.
justifications.business.marketDemand: B2B demand from attorneys/employers is steady but invisible to typical consumers.
justifications.business.efficiency: Vendor-specific certifications (Matheson, WorkWell) are achievable in 1-2 weeks of training.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Viewed as a clinical/business credential rather than an academic one; minimal hiring weight.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Limited peer-reviewed literature and ongoing debates about reliability/validity.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Fits narrowly into work rehab or industrial PT content; not core curriculum.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Evidence on FCE predictive validity is mixed and contested.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Rarely listed in academic postings outside specialized industrial rehab programs.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Quick to obtain, but academic payoff is small.
